name: AWL Agri Business Limited
summary: AWL Agri Business Ltd. mainly supplies edible oils, vanaspati and specialty fats. Its range also covers food staples like packed basmati rice, pulses, soya chunks and besan, as well as industrial ingredients such as lauric products, castor oils, oleo chemicals and non-GMO soya products. Established in January 1999, it is headquartered in Ahmedabad.
